description:
The scheme sdsc18 is known as the Skill Development Scheme for Children. 

It aims to provide skill development opportunities for children from economically weaker sections. 

The objective is to enhance the employability of children through vocational training. 

The scheme offers various skill development programs tailored to the needs of the local job market. 

Benefits include training in various trades and access to resources for skill development. 

Eligibility is primarily focused on children from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. 

The application process involves submitting an application form through designated centers. 

The timeline for the training programs may vary based on the specific trade and center. 

Implementing authorities include the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. 

The scheme may also involve partnerships with local training institutes and NGOs.
